statement: Dolphin 3eb30c7 assigns F7 a challenge-progress role associated with data at offset 0x50. Its enum distinguishes emulator-only activation 0x00, preparing 0x02, first-ready 0x0e and later second-stage values 0x14/0x1a. Its header comment describes hardware beginning at 0x02 after activation and progressing; Activate uses the emulator-only 0x00 until Update completes activation and selects 0x02. These source observations and a source comment are not physical readback of this project. Under the owner decision, the project compatibility policy holds F7 at 0x02 whenever the active-passthrough F6 mirror applies, never advances it and never serves 0x00 or readiness states. The challenge is unimplemented; offset 0x50 remains error 7. Dolphin ControllerInterface ignores F7 while decoding F6 read offsets 2,0,3, as recorded in wii-gap-dolphin-attach-passthrough-four-byte-id-f6. This fixed non-ready byte is compat, not faithful challenge emulation or a physical/game acceptance claim.
